text.en: Weaning the Calves, painted in 1879 by the French artist Rosa Bonheur, shows a mother cow watching over her young calves in a high mountain pasture in the Pyrenees. The calves gather near a rough wooden fence while the mother looks out at the viewer, calm and protective. Behind them, green slopes climb towards bare rocky peaks under a pale sky. Bonheur was famous for painting animals with great accuracy and sympathy, and she studied real farm animals closely before painting them. Every calf in the picture has its own pose and mood.
